music.selection_method: MASTER_PLAN 6.1: shortlist from the cached Mixkit catalogue (281 tracks parsed from 18 category pages saved 2026-10-22; no new catalogue requests), Pebble-profile ranking from tags and public waveform envelopes (tools/audio/mixkit_rank_pebble.py), then a no-ears audition of the top 5 (analyze_track.py PNGs, all looked at; Apple SoundAnalysis via sound_tags; rubric_metrics.py), scored with tools/audio/score_rubric.py and tools/audio/rubric_judgments.json.
music.audition_set_note: The ranker's top three (282, 431, 79) plus the plan's two other seeds (817, 148). Places 4-5 were a four-way tie at 10.8; the waveform envelopes showed 682, 717 (and 713, 710) are solo piano with no lift to put a reveal on, 614 is melancholic with a 42 s intro, 250 repeats 282 (same artist, tags and shape), 351 has no intro and 1037 is the flattest.

gates: power share above 150 Hz >= 0.30 (critic H9 small-speaker translation)

candidates.title: Young Trizzy 02
candidates.file: MP3 256 kb/s, decoded once with FFmpeg, resampled once to 48 kHz / 24-bit (soxr VHQ)

mood: relaxed, positive, melodic (Mixkit); genre trap / hip-hop
instrumentation: the bell and mallet melody fits the brief; the 808 sub and rolling trap hats do not
register: a hype-adjacent trap groove; SoundAnalysis hears its bells as a ringtone or telephone in 21 of 32 windows

intro: 7 bars of bells, 12 dB under the body
lift: a clear 808 drop at 13.76 s; the reveal would land at 18 %
ending: fades over about 2.3 s; no final chord

distinctiveness: trap with a bell hook; the hook sounds like a phone

candidates.title: Sweet September
candidates.file: MP3 256 kb/s, decoded once with FFmpeg, resampled once to 48 kHz / 24-bit (soxr VHQ)

instrumentation: chopped keys samples, hip-hop drums and a heavy sub-bass; no acoustic or mallet lead
register: calm, but the intro is stop-start chopped stabs with silent gaps

intro: 12.6 s (4 bars at 76 BPM), 9 dB under the body, chopped
lift: a clear drop at 12.66 s, but only 4 bars before it: the reveal would land at 17 % of the film

music.decision: No Mixkit candidate reached 70/100: the top stock score is 67 (431), which also fails the small-speaker gate like 282 (66); the best eligible track is 79 at 64. So the MASTER_PLAN 6.2 gate sends the film to the composed fallback. B1 (huashu-motion composer mode with its CC0 sample pack) could not be run: the session's permission system blocked executing that downloaded third-party CLI, so B2 was used: an original score rendered by our own code (tools/audio/compose_score.py, numpy + scipy + pedalboard), no samples and no third-party music. B1 stays available if the user approves running huashu-motion (pinned commit 52467f99c602b76ba86d511d37acdfe93fa1e16e).

original_score.title: Pebble launch cue (original score)
original_score.composed_for: this film (MASTER_PLAN 5.1 film plan, OVERRIDES 4: one timeline for 16:9 and 1:1)
original_score.generator: tools/audio/compose_score.py --seed 7 (deterministic: the same command rebuilds the same file bit for bit)
original_score.motif: D5 A5 G#5 A5 (eighth, eighth, sixteenth, dotted eighth tied)
original_score.instruments: modal-synthesis marimba, vibraphone, kalimba and glockenspiel; Karplus-Strong plucked bass; a soft saw pad; synthesised shaker and felt kick; a synthetic convolution reverb
original_score.licence: part of the film media, (c) 2026 Tohin Majumder

mood: calm, warm, hopeful D major with a Lydian twinkle in the motif; the tension bars move to minor colours
instrumentation: marimba, vibraphone, kalimba, plucked bass, soft pad, shaker: the brief's mallet palette (SoundAnalysis: mallet percussion 0.73, vibraphone 0.59, marimba 0.54), but synthesised, not recorded
register: low-key, written under the film's picture and sound effects

intro: hook and tension bars sparser than the body by 3-7 dB
lift: the reveal is written on bar 8 (frame 504) after an empty breath beat
ending: a final D(add9) chord on bar 31 rings for 4.8 s
breakdown: bars 26-28 drop drums and bass for the trust lines

distinctiveness: its own four-note motif, written for Pebble; mallet minimalism is a known idiom

original_score.needs: one human listen before the film ships (critic question 6); taste is the part an agent cannot verify
